table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ProductCode,
	Name,
	ChasisNo,
	EngineNo,
	Model=(SELECT M.Name FROM Model M WHERE M.ModelCode=Product.ModelCode),
	Purpose=(SELECT P.Name FROM ProductPurpose P WHERE P.ProductPurposeCode=Product.ProductPurposeCode),
	ProductType=(SELECT P.Name FROM ProductType P WHERE P.ProductTypeCode=Product.ProductTypeCode),
	Colour=(SELECT C.Name FROM ItemColour C WHERE C.IColourCode =Product.IColourCode),
	Supplier=(SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode =Product.SuppCode),
	Customer=(SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode =Product.CustCode),
	SalesMan=(SELECT S.Name FROM SalesMan S WHERE S.SalesmanCode =Product.SalesManCode),
	Finalized,
	Aquired,
	Delivered,
	Sold,
	OriginalDate,
	Date,
	FinalizedOn,
	AquiredOn,
	DeliveredOn,
	SoldOn
FROM
	DBO.Product
